verdict.rationale: Elastic's client docs say there is a "wide range of official libraries," and they describe a forward compatibility policy that bears on keeping clients current. However, the evidence never names which languages are covered, so coverage of JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby and Go is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit list of official SDK languages (JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go), framework integrations, evidence of release cadence or currency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs cover my language and framework, kept current across JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, and more

citations.quote: Elasticsearch is easy to use from most popular programming languages, thanks to the wide range of official libraries and developer tools available.
The forward compatibility policy allows client applications to continue to work with the new server before the client itself is upgraded.
use your preferred language to index data and run semantic and hybrid searches in 10 minutes.
